C1206.title: Scanning QR Code Login: How Fake QR Codes Steal Accounts via CSDN Blog
C1206.summary: This report describes an attack technique where fake login QR codes are used to steal user accounts. Attackers display a counterfeit QQ login QR code on a website, tricking victims into scanning and confirming the login.
